'''Mount Diligence''' was a hill on the planet [[Sarrassia/Legends|Sarrassia]]. It was considered a 'sacred ground' by the [[Grumani Hierophant]]s, a religious sect operating in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. It contained a cave which led to an underground lake and a [[Great Temple (Grumani)|large temple]] which contained the [[Helm of Ieldis]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] relic created by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ieldis]] prior to the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. During the [[Invasion of Sarrassia]] in the [[New Sith Wars]], the hill was assaulted by [[Odionate]] Sith forces under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Beld Yulan]] who slaughtered the Grumani defenders.
